final: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a, p.a - o.oa AS d FROM p, o WHERE p.a > o.oa), ka AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS kavg FROM k) SELECT k.ID, k.a AS patient_avg, k.d AS diff_overall, k.a - ka.kavg AS diff_kept FROM k JOIN ka ON ka.kavg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_kept DESC LIMIT 10
